cues: Worked example four point five, limestone.
First, convert entropy to kilojoules: zero point one six zero six.
At two ninety eight kelvin, delta G is one seventy eight point three minus forty seven point nine, plus one thirty point four kilojoules.
Positive, so limestone does not decompose at room temperature.
Lucky, since so many buildings in Nepal are made of it.
